title: Lamis Network
description:
Lamis Network provides IP intelligence, autonomous system details, infrastructure classification, and real-time fraud risk scoring hosted in Austria (EU).

Key features:

- Real-time IP fraud and risk scoring (0-100)
- Autonomous System (ASN) context with belongs-to relationships
- Geolocation enrichment (Country, City) with located-at relationships
- Infrastructure classification: Datacenter, VPN, Tor exit node, Public Proxy
- Configurable threshold for suspicious tagging
- Strict TLP enforcement before external API dispatch
short_description: Lamis Network connector enriches IPv4 and IPv6 observables with ASN, geolocation, infrastructure classification, and fraud risk scores.
